main.description: One release by exact version. Served whatever its status, including `deleted`: that is the left-pad protection the registry exists for.

version.description: Semver without build metadata, exactly as the record key carries it.

errors.name: ReleaseNotFound
errors.description: No release is indexed at that version.

errors.name: NotConfigured
errors.description: The registry instance has no identity configured (HAPPYPROTO_DID), so it cannot read its own state. An operator problem, not a caller's.
